scope: Official Anthropic docs only (docs.claude.com / docs.anthropic.com / platform.claude.com prompting best-practices and per-model pages for Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5). Look them up now; do not answer from memory.
Compare against packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/ (root and specialist sections) and packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/requirements.md if present, read-only.
